title: LedgerAccount (DRAFT)
description: One account in the chart of accounts (FIN-001). DRAFT — not approved.

code.description: Stable account code, unique within a tenant.

normalBalance.description: Stored rather than inferred so a report can never disagree with the ledger about which direction is 'more'. Assets and expenses must be debit; the rest credit.

currency.description: An account holds one currency. Cross-currency movement goes through an explicit fx_conversion transaction (FIN-005).

partyId.description: Set for accounts belonging to a party, such as a payee's obligation account. Null for organizational accounts.

_note: Suggested minimal chart: 1000 provider balance (asset), 2000 owed to landowner (liability), 4000 sponsorship revenue (revenue), 5000 provider fees (expense). The actual chart is an accounting decision, not an engineering one.
